_source: Lucid Trading — LucidFlex evaluation, 50K. Rules read 2026-10-29; confirm on your dashboard after any firm update.

drawdown.basis: end-of-day balance high-water mark — intraday excursions do not count

consistency.applies_to: evaluation only; the rule is dropped once funded
consistency.formula: largest single day profit / account profit must be at or below the limit

desk.book: three NQ daily rules, one micro each: nr_break-2 1.0A tp2, nday_break-1 1.0A tp2, nday_fade-5 0.75A tp1
desk.why: One leg stops out for about $645 on today's NQ, which is 1.3% of a $50K. The three rules can all stop on the same session, and that day is $1,769 — 88% of the $2,000 buffer — so the buffer holds a median session (1,158) 1.7 times over and a three-leg losing day not quite once. That is the price of the profit: the trio's median 40-session window is +$4,588 at one micro, and the worst is -$4,647. A 25K at the same size carried a $1,158 median session against a $1,000 allowance and died; the 50K is the smallest account that can hold this book.
